title: Checked natural multiplication
summary: Executes the compiler's staged natural multiplication guard and result sequence for a product below 2^64, preserving the store and operand-stack tail.
premises: Exact equality with the emitted checked multiplication region
Combined getters for the staged UInt64 operands
The natural product of the operand values is below 2^64
The continuation after pushing the product
result: The emitted guard avoids overflow and division traps, pushes the product, and preserves the store, parameters, internal locals, and original stack tail.
